title: astragalus emoryanus var. terlinguensis
intro: Astragalus emoryanus var. terlinguensis, commonly known as Emory's milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant native to North America. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include immune system support, anti-inflammatory properties, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Emory's milkvetch include modulating the immune response, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
